issue: श्री प्रताप आरती मैया की — प्रताप may be the poet's signature (as names close many āratīs) or a word of the line (the glorious āratī of the Mother); no witness names a poet. Every witness has प्रताप here.
our reading: Śrī Pratāp (the poet): whoever sings the Mother's āratī …
alternatives: The glorious (प्रताप) āratī of the Mother: whoever sings it …

issue: देवन अरज करत तव चित को लाता — read as 'the gods make their plea and bring it to your heart (attention)'; Drik Panchang has हम for देवन.
our reading: The gods make their plea and bring it to your heart.
alternatives: The gods make their plea, setting their minds (चित) on you.
